_comment: Requirement schema per true_grind design docs: requirements array is ANDed. type 'proficiency' = weapon/magic stat. type 'classLevel' = must have leveled a prerequisite class. This file starts with just enough classes for Milestone 1 (Fencer) plus two more to prove the classLevel-chained schema works before more classes get added in later milestones.

classes.name: Medic
classes.fantasy: Knows one spell and it's a good one

classes.name: Staff Adept
classes.fantasy: Student of the quarterstaff and conduit arts

classes.name: Combat Medic
classes.fantasy: Field triage specialist keeping allies on their feet

classes.name: Ember Adept
classes.fantasy: Can light a candle. Sometimes a person.

classes.name: Sprout Keeper
classes.fantasy: Talks to plants; plants don't answer yet

classes.name: Gale Adept
classes.fantasy: Can ruin someone's hair from a distance

classes.name: Stoneheart Initiate
classes.fantasy: Can crack a rock. On purpose, mostly.

classes.name: Restoration Mage
classes.fantasy: Pure support specialist dedicated entirely to healing and party warding

classes.name: Apprentice Armorer
classes.fantasy: Shaping raw hide and silk into life-saving protection

classes.name: Apprentice Smith
classes.fantasy: Pounding raw iron and salvaged alloys into balanced instruments of war

classes.name: Apprentice Alchemist
classes.fantasy: Distilling essences, herbs, and bone dust into restorative elixirs

classes.name: Excavator
classes.fantasy: Learning where the ground hides things

classes.name: Apprentice Bowyer
classes.fantasy: Carving timber and weaving strings into flexible ranged bows

classes.name: Scout

classes.name: Locksmith
classes.fantasy: Patient hands and an ear for the tumblers
